name: plan-coverage
body: The coverage rule of the plan-verify gate: for every solution node whose `implemented-by` claim changed between the branch's merge-base and the branch tip, each affected code FQN must be touched by a plan task; unchanged pre-existing claims impose no obligation however the spine reaches them. Coverage is verb-agnostic, counts a `renames`/`moves` destination, and compares code FQNs by language-agnostic identity. An in-scope solution node with no `implemented-by` edge is a warning (`no_claims`), never a blocker.
